title: `destructiveHint`
description: An MCP tool annotation the author sets to declare that a tool is destructive, it deletes data, is irreversible, or has a large blast radius. It lives in the tool's `annotations` object alongside readOnlyHint, idempotentHint and openWorldHint.
question: Is the destructive marker present at each capture boundary?
notes: Mixed across the 2 adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: OpenAI Agents SDK: FunctionTool retains the MCP title only; the behavioral hint is not carried.
notes_by_num.4: Pydantic AI: retained in ToolDefinition.metadata['annotations']; not part of parameters_json_schema.
notes_by_num.5: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Mixed across the 2 adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.
verdict.detail: Pydantic AI 2.40.0 changes it or retains it elsewhere; OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 drops it entirely. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers declaring this annotation. Not estimated, the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
known_issues: Pydantic AI retains the annotation outside its declared tool-definition capture object; OpenAI Agents SDK does not.
Three framework adapters could not be measured against 2026-07-28, so missing evidence is not a support result.

after: : no annotations field exists in this format

why: A guardrail reading only either measured capture object receives no structured destructive signal. Pydantic AI still holds the value where an application policy layer can read it; OpenAI Agents SDK does not. This measurement does not claim what a later provider request contains.
